candidates.intent: Fallback for stalled unpermitted lanes. Rank lateral and retreat station alternatives from public swept geometry, use bounded robot path search, and re-enter push through the existing review gate.
candidates.name: trial01

candidates.intent: Replace independent detour proposer with a bounded fallback that searches general solo relief directions and robot station paths after the normal permits fail. Preserve parent primary policy, rolling static map and event previews.
candidates.name: trial02

candidates.intent: Restore parent detour and regular pushes. After sustained target stagnation and ordinary permit exhaustion, try fairly ranked visible solo relief pairs through the same review, and avoid revisiting near-goal inspection positions after a prolonged stall.
candidates.name: trial03

nomination.name: trial03
nomination.reason: Best observed development success, 3/16 versus parent 2/16. Retained 001, gained 003 and 011, and regressed 012. Restores parent detour and limits additional solo options to sustained stalls through the shared checked gate. Public endpoint contradictions increased, and transfer remains unverified.

event.evidence: Parent succeeds in 2/16. In room 006, all 48 late ordinary decisions cite observed_sweep_too_short and gap stays near 2.15 m. In room 008, 18 late decisions cite the same reason and final gap stays near 0.65 m. The checked prefixes each report one proposed pair out of 32 passing menu pairs. These are public estimated outcomes.
event.proposed_change: Preserve the normal gate and add a stalled fallback that considers every eligible solo push direction, including lateral relief, plus bounded robot station routing when the current lane cannot be used.

event.evidence: Trial 01 rejected before compilation because it exceeds 48 KiB. Whitespace packing reduced it to 52,919 bytes, still over capacity.
event.proposed_change: Trial 02 replaces the old independent detour subplanner with the new stalled fallback while preserving its rolling static map and the parent primary ranking/review gate. Carrier packing preserves exact substantive tokens and nesting.

event.evidence: Trial 02 accepted and ran all 16 rooms, with 0/16 successes. It regressed both parent successes after changing stance at ticks 880 and 846 while the parent still recovered without intervention. Some progress improved (003 estimated best gap 1.75 to .183 m); 006 still cycled between alternate stations. Estimated continuation witnesses were 469/548 vs 430/512 for parent; estimated endpoint contradictions rose from 61/512 to 79/548.
event.proposed_change: Restore complete parent detour logic. Only after sustained stalling and rejection of the ordinary proposals, check visible clear solo relief lanes. Near the goal after a longer stall, adjust the fallback re-view move to penalize recent visits. Keep all candidates under the same actual review gate.

event.decision: Nominate trial03 by observed whole-room success. No tested revision both improved the aggregate and retained all parent successes. Out-of-panel success is unverified.
event.evidence: Trial 03 passed common submission and went 3/16 versus parent 2/16. It preserved 001, gained 003 and 011, and lost 012. First changed commands were at 1521, 976, 1012, and 926 ticks respectively, all shifting the first response from target-free stance movement to an assessed solo push with YIELD. Trace association alone does not identify individual action causality. Named continuation/goal occurred in 466/543 estimated reports vs 430/512. Estimated endpoint contradictions rose to 91/543 from 61/512, with 196/543 and 188/512 unknown respectively; these are public estimates and do not establish true physical endpoint accuracy.

candidates.intent: Preserve the nominal policy and activate a bounded alternative normal-direction search only after sustained short swept lanes or prolonged target stagnation. Keep the common ordinary and checkpoint review.
candidates.name: trial03

nomination.name: parent
nomination.reason: Verified parent preserves both parent successes. Trial01 won 5/16 but retained neither the 001 nor 012 parent wins. Trial02 and trial03 did not pass the common submission, so no tested improvement met the parent preservation objective.

event.change: Add recovery-only reachable face stations for all estimated target normals, orbit corners, public obstacle/peer checks and one-robot MOVE scoring. Keep push review and checkpoints.
event.evidence: Parent success 001/012 only. 002, 006, 015 spend 41, 52, 28 decisions respectively on short sweeps; 008 and repeated trace variants stall near goal, and 011 alternates MOVE near final stance. Existing MOVE picks goal-side waypoints without assessing reachable alternate support stations.
event.limitation: Reachability is two local legs and sampled point clearance with imperfect observed pose, so cannot guarantee a full path.

event.change: Restore the original repositioning and keep special station planning dormant until the observed target has stalled 150 ticks. Add short bounded alternate pushes based on reachable observed faces, lane clearance, and onward clearance after conservative proposals fail. Keep full ordinary and event-time gate.
event.evidence: Trial01 accepted, 5/16 vs parent 2/16, but lost both parent wins. First divergence was tick 28 on the shared opening. 001 and 012 then cycle in inferior early stances. 003 reduced final gap 1.839 to .443.
event.limitation: To fit the carrier, replace the inherited auxiliary detour module with this recovery logic while keeping its static cell accumulation. Behavior before trigger is expected to match on studied openings, with former detour intervention timing not guaranteed.

event.change: Trial03 leaves the inherited nominal behavior, late detour module and event previews intact. Persistent observed short sweeps or one longer no-progress window activate a four-normal alternate direction search. Rank by goal projection, forward clearance, expected onward clearance and robot access, then run existing legal push review and positioning toward a support station.
event.evidence: Trial02 error expected ordinary bounded candidate source after author request was published before source. Trial01 net +3 lost both original successes, and the early change was shared. Parent winning traces never recorded observed_sweep_too_short and did resolve two long station changes. Several failures repeatedly reported blocked sweeps from mid-route onward.
event.limitation: Thresholds are development-derived. One-step onward geometry is a hypothesis, and farther route changes are unverified. Observed trace variants can be redundant.

event.change: Nominate the verified parent because it is the only eligible policy that retains both parent successes. An equivalent nested ordinary loop could avoid the Cython closure in a future authorized test.
event.evidence: Trial03 returned error before evaluation. The host C compiler reported that generated Cython closure for the nested candidate generator refers to a missing __pyx_outer_scope. Trial02 was never compiled because it was requested before its source was available. Trial01 accepted with 5/16 but all five wins are newly successful room entries; neither parent win was retained.
event.limitation: No ticket remains to verify the proposed conservative adaptation. The nomination has no demonstrated development gain.
